fetch.note: Apple does not say how often it fetches a feed. 24 hours is News Distribution's own guess, used only to say when a fetch is later than usual.

feed.atom_self.note: Include the atom:link tag with rel="self" for RSS and Atom feeds.

title.length.note: Apple's guide says titles should be between 15 and 60 characters long, but there is no minimum. It is a recommendation, so News Distribution only warns and keeps the article in the feed.

page.image_tag.note: Apple's guide names og:image as a source for the feed thumbnail. It does not call it a rule, so a missing tag is a risk, not an error.

page.author_tag.note: A check News Distribution adds: an author tag (meta author or article:author) on the article page. Apple's page does not say how it finds the author.

page.language_tag.note: A check News Distribution adds: a language tag (og:locale) on the article page. Apple's page does not say how it finds the language.

content.marking.source: Apple Support, "AI-generated content in Apple News" (link to be confirmed)
content.marking.note: Apple asks publishers to mark syndicated and AI-generated content in News Publisher. News Distribution cannot mark it there; it lists the articles you labeled.

feed.format.note: RSS 2.0 in UTF-8. The HTTPS part is checked by News Distribution; Apple's page was not re-read for it.

item.required_fields.note: A title, a link and a description on every item. RSS 2.0 asks for these; Apple's page was not re-read for a stricter rule.

url.missing.note: Every item needs the article address.

body.empty.note: An article with no text has nothing to send in the feed.

author.missing.note: No author name could be found for the article.

body.full_text.note: News Distribution sends the full text of each article in content:encoded.

body.clean.note: News Distribution removes ad blocks, related-story blocks and social share links from the body. This is its own tidy-up, not an Apple rule.

markup.wordpress.note: The hidden notes WordPress adds around blocks, and shortcodes, are removed from the feed when this option is on.

guid.stable.note: An item keeps the same guid when the article is updated, so a reader of the feed sees one article, not a new one.

feed.delay.note: A new article joins the feed after the index-first delay when that option is on.
